connector.name: Coredash
connector.registryDescription: Real User Monitoring for Core Web Vitals. Query LCP, INP, CLS field data from real visitors.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.coredash.app over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the corewebvitals account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token in the format 'Bearer cdk_YOUR_API_KEY'. Generate a key at https://coredash.app/settings/api. OAuth is also supported via WWW-Authenticate discovery.
